Name: Cooking Food Price and Stat Overhaul
Author: ShadowNinja85
Description:
Cooked Foods always seems like an afterthought in Stardew Valley. Many of the recipes are unprofitable to make even with normal quality ingredients, and a lot of cooked food gives you less health & energy then the individual ingredients used to cook it, especially when higher quality ingredients are used.

This mod re-balances most cooked foods in the game in the following ways:

[list]
[*]Cooking is always profitable even when using iridium ingredients. The new gold price was determined by adding up the selling price of iridium quality ingredients (where applicable), adding a 20% profit margin to compensate our farmer for their time & labor, and rounding the price up to the nearest number that ended in a 5 or 0.
[*]The above price calculations make the most favorable assumptions for your Professions. So for example Fish all get a 50% price bump from the Angler profession, Cheese gets a 40% boost from the Artisan Profession.
[/list][list]
[*]The new health & energy stats were determined by adding up the health & energy stats of the individual ingredients. In cases where the original health/energy stats were higher then this number I kept the original value. In cases where an item has no health & energy stats (like Pumpkins) I assigned it a value similar to other ingredients of the same cost & type (for example Mussel & Periwinkle got the same health & energy stats as a sunfish).
[*]Any other stat gains from food (like Luck & Speed gains) are untouched by this mod.
[/list]

[b]Note #1:[/b] Two cooked foods were left untouched by this mod. Algae Soup, and Pale Broth. Both cost much more then their algae ingredients, and give much more health & energy, so I decided to leave them alone.

[b]Note #2[/b]: For the two Foods that require "Any Fish" as an ingredient I used a low level fish in my calculations for both selling price and stat gains, because otherwise Sashimi would be incredibly broken.

[b]IMPORTANT:[/b]

This mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] in order for shops to automatically adjust their item prices. Otherwise you may have infinite money glitches where Gus/etc. might sell items for less then their value.

[b]Patch 1.6:[/b] Added Moss Soup.
